details.description: Karachi Bakery’s Besan Phalli is a flavourful snack made from peanuts coated in spiced chickpea (besan) flour and deep-fried to perfection. With its rich, nutty crunch and bold seasoning, it’s a delightful treat for anytime munching. Enjoy it on its own or pair it with your favourite cool beverage for a satisfying experience.

A spicy and savoury snack made from premium-quality peanuts coated in a robust blend of traditional Indian spices. Perfectly roasted for a crunchy bite, this masala phalli (spiced peanut) is ideal for evening snacks or party appetisers.

Karachi Bakery’s Masala Green Peas offer a bold, crunchy snacking experience. Coated in a flavourful masala blend, these crispy green peas are packed with taste and make for a protein-rich munch. Enjoy them as a guilt-free snack during work breaks or evening tea — a spicy twist to your everyday nibbles.

Karachi Bakery’s Garlic Mixture is a bold, flavourful snack packed with the punch of garlic. This traditional blend combines sev, boondi, and crunchy elements for a satisfying crunch in every bite. Free from added colours and preservatives, it’s a delicious choice for those who enjoy robust, spiced snacks with an authentic touch.

Karachi Bakery’s Khatta Meetha Mixture is a delightful blend of puffed rice, sev, boondi, peanuts, and select spices. With its perfect balance of sweet and tangy flavours, this traditional snack brings a burst of taste and texture in every bite. Ideal for tea-time or casual snacking, it’s a timeless favourite for all ages.

Karachi Bakery’s Navratan Mixture is a festive blend of nine flavourful ingredients, including crunchy nuts, savoury lentils, crisp sev, and aromatic spices. This traditional snack delivers a balanced mix of sweet, tangy, and spicy notes in every bite. Ideal for celebrations or everyday indulgence, it’s a versatile munch to savour anytime.

Savour the traditional taste of Karachi Bakery's Khara Boondi – tiny, crispy gram flour droplets seasoned with mild spices. With no added colours or preservatives, this snack is perfect on its own or as a crunchy topping for raita and chaats. A classic Indian savoury that adds texture and flavour to every bite.

Karachi Bakery’s Methi Puri is a fresh and crispy snack made from wheat flour, seasoned with dried fenugreek leaves and select spices. These golden, deep-fried discs offer a rich, aromatic flavour in every bite. Enjoy them on their own, or pair with chutney or pickle for a truly satisfying and traditional snacking experience.

Karachi Bakery’s Namak Para is a classic savoury snack made from refined flour, lightly seasoned and fried to a golden, crunchy finish. These diamond-shaped bites offer a simple yet satisfying flavour, perfect for tea-time munching or casual snacking. Enjoy their crisp texture and mild saltiness any time of day, alone or with your favourite beverage.
